tickets.title: Follow up on missing signature
tickets.text: Request the missing trustee-capacity signature needed to complete the Paper Otter Custody taxable transfer authorization for Elias Copperwisp. Include where to sign, how to return it, and that Velvet Acorn Custody cannot process the transfer until the signed item is received.

tickets.title: Track custodian transfer progress
tickets.text:
Use this checklist to monitor the Paper Otter Custody IRA transfer for Elias Copperwisp, including the proprietary Paper Otter Stable Income Fund position (about $82,000) that requires a decision on liquidation, exchange, or leaving behind:

- Confirm transfer type and delivering custodian requirements.
- Verify receiving account is open and registration matches transfer instructions.
- Check that all required transfer forms are complete, current, and signed.
- Confirm whether medallion guarantee, statement copy, cost basis data, or liquidation instructions are required.
- Record date submitted through the approved channel.
- Monitor custodian status updates and note any rejection reason or additional requirement.
- Confirm assets or cash arrived in the receiving account.
- Reconcile transferred positions, cash, cost basis, and residual sweeps.
- Notify advisor of any restricted, proprietary, illiquid, or nontransferable holdings.
- Document completion and any remaining follow-up items.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve how to handle that position by November 18, 2025.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position
tickets.text: Review the concentrated Moonbadger Automation position (about $385,000 with a low reported cost basis) in Elias Copperwisp's transferring Paper Otter Custody taxable account. Balance exposure reduction against the high-income 2025 tax year (joint taxable income projected at about $310,000 by CPA Talia Bramblequill) and document recommended actions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is a review by November 26, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a retirement income plan for Elias and Lena Copperwisp that identifies expected spending needs, reliable income sources, portfolio withdrawal strategy, tax considerations, reserve targets, and implementation actions. Use current client data and clearly note assumptions, risks, and follow-up items. The plan should model Elias's mid-2027 employment transition away from Clockwork Clover Design and Lena's 2030 freelance wind-down using household spending of about $11,800 per month, Social Security estimates of $3,050 (Elias) and $2,100 (Lena) at full retirement age, transferred assets, and tax projections.

subTasks.title: Gather income and spending inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates (about $11,800 per month including mortgage), Social Security assumptions ($3,050 for Elias, $2,100 for Lena at full retirement age), pension details, required distributions, cash reserves (Elias prefers roughly nine months of regular spending), and known one-time expenses. Note any missing items for client follow-up.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax-aware sequencing
subTasks.text: Compare sustainable withdrawal options, account sequencing, Roth conversion considerations, and taxable income impacts for Elias's mid-2027 employment transition and Lena's 2030 freelance wind-down. Document planning assumptions and sensitivity points.

subTasks.title: Align portfolio and cash reserve strategy
subTasks.text: Review allocation, liquidity needs, near-term distribution sources, and risk exposure. Identify trades, cash raises, or rebalancing actions needed to support the income plan, including the Teacup Comet Bank cash position and the nine-month reserve target.

subTasks.title: Prepare client summary and implementation list
subTasks.text: Draft a plain-language summary with recommended distribution approach, monitoring cadence, open questions, and action items for advisor review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that model by December 5, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate charitable transfer
tickets.text: Coordinate the charitable transfer request for Elias Copperwisp, ensuring the receiving charity information, asset source, tax documentation needs, and completion confirmation are handled through appropriate handoffs. The gift involves appreciated Moonbadger Automation shares from the Paper Otter Custody taxable account to Whistling Pebble Literacy Fund, with delivery required during the current tax year.

subTasks.title: Confirm charitable transfer intent and recipient details
subTasks.text: Confirm the gift purpose, asset or cash source (appreciated Moonbadger Automation shares from the Paper Otter Custody taxable account), approximate amount or shares, receiving charity legal name (Whistling Pebble Literacy Fund), delivery instructions, and whether the client needs recognition preferences documented.

subTasks.title: Prepare transfer instructions for review

subTasks.title: Submit and monitor transfer status
subTasks.text: After approval and signatures are complete, submit through the approved channel and track custodian or charity confirmation until assets or funds are received before year end.

subTasks.title: Document confirmation and tax records
subTasks.text: Save confirmation, receipt, acknowledgement letter, and any relevant tax-reporting notes to the client file. Flag missing receipts or discrepancies for advisor review.
